name: Nat's Measuring Tape
label: Quest
description: Nat's Measuring Tape: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Amongst the shattered fishing lures and tackle is a rolled, silken measuring tape. Attached to the tape is a label that reads:

clips.title: Completion
paras: Why, you found my favorite measuring tape! I love this tape! I measured some of the biggest fish I ever caught with it...
But, I lost this tape in Zul'Gurub... You've been to Zul'Gurub? Did you see the fabled Gahz'ranka?
Well... Do you want to catch him?
